# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus 1.0

**One point oh.** Built on [saulob's open-source PC port](https://github.com/saulob/geometry-wars-retro-evolved-2-recompiled), PC Plus brings Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 home to the PC with everything below. This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## New in 1.0

- **A roomier main menu.** The menu is back to the game's own six rows at full size. **Watch replays** and **Custom modes** live in panels in the black space either side: press **left** or **right** to step into one (the menu dims so only one thing is chosen), **A** (Enter) to open it, and **B** (Esc) or the other way to step back. The mouse works too.

## Everything in PC Plus

- **Mouse aim** with an animated neon crosshair, full keyboard support, keyboard prompts and a controls page.
- **Online leaderboards** with your own player name, and the players near your score filling the Friends rows and the HUD's score to beat.
- **Watch the top runs:** replays of every leaderboard's top 50, from Watch replays or **Watch Replay** on the game's own leaderboard screen, opening on the run just above yours. Your own top 50 bests are shared, and one launcher setting turns that off.
- **Master Deadline and Master Evolved:** one ship, a bomb at 100K, 1M, 10M and 100M, and their own leaderboards, on the Master page of Single Player (RB or 3).
- **Custom modes** made from a small text file, with five to start from, like Pure Pacifism.
- **Every mode open from the start**, no unlocking.
- **Replays** of every run, and a **results screen** after each one: your score over time, the enemies you destroyed, and what your black holes and gates were worth.
- **Colour themes** for menus, HUD and crosshair, from Green to Rainbow or any colour you like.
- **A Fast render path** for laptops and Intel graphics, and a **benchmark** in the launcher.
- **A launcher** that looks like the game, with your name on every page and a link to the [Discord](https://discord.gg/ZJtcwYPN7).

Thank you to everyone on the Discord for playing, testing and setting the scores to chase.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v1.0.0-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
